issues.detail: The Greek 'δια λογου πολλου' (by much speech/word) refers to the *means* of their exhortation, not the *content* of their speech. The Vietnamese 'dùng nhiều lời khuyên bảo' (used many words of advice) slightly shifts the focus from the volume/extent of their speaking to the specific content of 'advice' (khuyên bảo).
